recorded_before: clean DEV3 and FINAL results (neither observed)

environment.answer: run at an idle time: the user stops other sessions while away (~4h) and notifies the agent
environment.agent_check_before_start: record uptime load averages and top CPU processes before DEV3 and before FINAL; do not start while an external process holds sustained high CPU
environment.clarification: Load affects only latency/cold start (N10); citations, recall/MRR and abstention are deterministic for the same inputs.

final_rule.answer: run FINAL even if some arm's DEV p95 ratio exceeds 1.25
final_rule.consequence: FINAL records the current fix level; any arm over 1.25 leaves N10 unmet. Later improvements cannot be confirmed on an independent FINAL.
